Real trading education, built in public over three and a half years. Technical analysis, derivatives, trading psychology, and fundamental analysis, taught the way it was actually learned, through wins, losses, and the discipline to keep showing up. No tips, no guaranteed returns.

// the ff approach

Learn to read the
market. Not follow it.

Every setup starts with understanding what's actually happening, not chasing what already happened. Six ideas, in order, that everything else builds on.

01

Price

What is price actually doing, right now, before any indicator tells you a story about it.

02

Structure

Trend, range, acceptance, rejection. The shape the market is currently in.

03

Participation

Futures, options, and who's actually positioned, not just what the candle looks like.

04

Risk

Survival comes before returns. Every setup gets sized before it gets taken.

05

Psychology

Execution over emotion. The plan only works if it survives contact with the trade.

06

Framework

One repeatable process, built by you, that doesn't change with your mood.
